verdict.rationale: Docs show Radar assigns a risk_level (e.g., 'highest') synchronously to charges created via test cards, implying risk evaluation happens as part of the same API call used to create a charge/PaymentIntent, and Radar Standard is described as providing out-of-the-box real-time fraud protection. However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents the risk_score field, exact API response shape, or explicit timing relative to authorization completion. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the outcome.risk_score attribute returned on Charge/PaymentIntent objects, and explicit confirmation that scoring occurs before authorization completes rather than just being attached to the resulting charge.
